text: Tested: 100 nearby runs, all droplet flames from NASA's FLEX experiment, with oxygen between 17% and 24% and pressure near 1 atm. Outcomes: 62 extinction (flame went out), 25 disruption (droplet broke apart), and 13 completion (fuel burned away). One FLEX methanol test at 21% oxygen and 1 atm describes flame extinction as the droplet shrinks to a smaller diameter. The evidence rests on 100 runs from one experiment and one flame type.
